“Strengthen the Feeble Knees” By Elder Marvin J. Ashton Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles There is a phrase used four times in the standard works which has always intrigued me. It is the expression “feeble knees.” By definition, feeble means weak, not strong, without force, easily broken, frail.
